personality_one_liner: A friendly, touchable, and vibrant card game experience grounded in warm oriental terracotta and sand tones.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around content to enhance the tactile feel. No cramped elements. Touch targets at least 44pt.

do's: Use glass effect for bottom tab bar and featured event cards over oriental patterned backgrounds.
Pair blur with tinted base (≥70% opacity) for readability.
Apply glass to modals/overlays over the game table.
dont's: Never blur body text regions or form fields.
Do not over-use glass on individual playing cards; they should feel solid and tactile.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Google and email login with language selection (FR/AR).

states.error: Toast using error token with Retry button.

screens.layout: Screen background uses moroccan_pattern layered with brandTertiary gradient. Oversized brandword mark at top, large chunky pill buttons for Google and Email at the bottom thumb zone.

screens.name: Home Lobby
screens.purpose: Matchmaking hub to choose short/long match, or create/join private parties.

states.empty: No active match found - prompt to create party.
states.error: Failed to connect to matchmaking server.

screens.layout: Large featured cards for 'Play Online' and 'Private Party' stacked vertically. Glassmorphism over the patterned background. Bottom sheet for selecting 1000/2000 points and activating commercials (toggle).

screens.name: Game Table
screens.purpose: First-person immersive multiplayer card game view.

states.empty: Waiting for players to join seats.

screens.layout: Horizontal perspective table filling the screen with emerald/sand texture. 3 opponent avatars placed in 'seats' around the top edge and sides. The player's hand (8 cards) fanned at the bottom, overlapping and draggable. Trick play area centered. Floating pill actions for Belote announcements and contracts.

screens.name: Leaderboard

states.empty: Play a game to appear on the leaderboard.

screens.layout: Top section features the player's ELO and rank. Below is a scrollable list of top players, alternating soft list rows with thick left border accents. Uses the trophy image as a header graphic.

screens.name: Profile & Statistics
screens.purpose: Avatar selection, language toggle, and game statistics.
screens.layout: Large rounded square showing the selected funny avatar. Grid of chunky statistic blocks (win rate, total games played). A horizontal scroll shelf of available funny avatars for selection.

screens.name: Friends
screens.purpose: Manage contacts and invite friends to private parties.

states.empty: A playful 3D avatar holding a sign: 'No friends yet, add some!'

screens.layout: Simple vertical list of friends with their funny avatars. Large primary CTA 'Add Friend' sticky at the bottom over scrolling content.

oriental_pattern_bg.alt: Moroccan geometric pattern texture in sand and terracotta

hero_cards_chips.alt: Poker cards and game chips on table

funny_avatar_2.alt: Funny 3D avatar character with crazy hair

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the Game Table strictly follows a first-person perspective layout, showing opponent avatars around the top/sides of the screen, with the player's 8-card hand anchored at the bottom.
Use Phosphor icons in filled style (24-28pt) throughout the app to match the Tactile / Playful personality.
Banned colors (indigo, purple, all blues, navy, violet) must not be used anywhere. The theme revolves around warm sand, terracotta, and emerald green tones.
Avatars must use the selected funny 3D characters fetched via unsplash, set inside round tactile borders.
Text laid over the oriental patterned backgrounds MUST use a gradient-to-dark scrim (top-to-bottom transparent to surfaceInverse at ≥70%) to ensure WCAG readability.
Implement the 'commercials/ads activation' toggle inside the profile or matchmaking lobby as an opt-in or premium switch.
Buttons should be chunky and tactile (pill shape), with 'Continue/Play' CTAs sticky at the bottom over a frosted glass or surface background.
Language toggle (FR/AR) must trigger layout mirroring (RTL for Arabic) across all screens.
